    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier
    FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."loss_payment"
    UNION
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier
    FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."loss_reserve"
    UNION
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier
    FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."expense_payment"
    UNION
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier
    FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."expense_reserve"
),
claim_losses AS (
    SELECT
        c.Claim_Identifier,
        c.Company_Claim_Number,
        SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS loss_amount
    FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."claim" AS c
    LEFT JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."claim_amount" AS ca
        ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
        AND ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (
            SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier
            FROM loss_component_ids
        )
    GROUP BY c.Claim_Identifier, c.Company_Claim_Number
),
claim_policy AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        c.Claim_Identifier,
        c.Company_Claim_Number,
        p.Policy_Identifier,
        p.Policy_Number
    FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."claim" AS c
    JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."claim_coverage" AS cc
        ON cc.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
    JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."policy_coverage_detail" AS pcd
        ON pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
    JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."policy" AS p
        ON p.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
)
SELECT
    cp.Policy_Number,
    cp.Policy_Identifier,
    CAST(SUM(COALESCE(cl.loss_amount, 0)) AS DOUBLE)
        / COUNT(DISTINCT cp.Claim_Identifier) AS average_loss,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cp.Claim_Identifier) AS claim_count
FROM claim_policy AS cp
JOIN claim_losses AS cl
    ON cl.Claim_Identifier = cp.Claim_Identifier
    AND cl.Company_Claim_Number = cp.Company_Claim_Number
GROUP BY cp.Policy_Number, cp.Policy_Identifier
ORDER BY cp.Policy_Number, cp.Policy_Identifier
LIMIT 500
